h33-h33-2-b2-MASSm10minus-20261023-71329.hypothesis: R0's dots that sit in the near-catalogue collar carry less credit than the metric's break-even, so deleting them raises DTI even though some are close to known traces.
h33-h33-2-b2-MASSm10minus-20261023-71329.mechanism: Binary-dot algebra (vendor/gems57/metric.py): DTI = T/(0.2*(T+n-M)+0.8|G|). Removing one dot lowers the denominator by exactly 0.2 regardless of its credit, so a removal gains iff that dot's realised credit to unseen truth is below 0.2*DTI = 0.0556 at DTI 0.2778. The removed set is concentrated in the collar, which is the region where the 0.2708->0.2778 prune paid.
h33-h33-2-b2-MASSm10minus-20261023-71329.ranking_basis: 0.6*clip(d_catalogue_px/50) + 0.4*uniform(seed88). This is NOT the parent's model ranking: R0's score field is not stored anywhere (every H33-lineage raster is binary). 40% of the score is uniform noise and 20% of parent dots saturate the distance term at 1.0.

h33-h33-2-b2-CONCb10px-m10-20261023-89ff.hypothesis: At a fixed dot count, raising local dot density on the parent's most confident km-scale clusters raises the metric more than the relocation costs, because the metric's false-positive term is sum_x p(x)(1 - max_g k): a dot welded next to an already-covering dot pays almost no penalty (0.2(1 - k) ~ 0.07 at 1 px) while a dot in an empty km block pays the full 0.2. Mass moved out of the coldest blocks therefore relieves denominator weight that the parent was still paying.
h33-h33-2-b2-CONCb10px-m10-20261023-89ff.mechanism: DTI = T / (0.2T + 0.2(n - M) + 0.8|G|) with n fixed at 37654. Each move changes the denominator by 0.2(t_add - t_rm + m_rm - m_add). Donors are drawn from the coldest 1 km blocks (mean block prior 0.75 dots/km2) where m_rm ~ 0; receivers land in blocks with mean prior 2.54 dots/km2 at 1.04 px from a surviving host, so m_add is inherited from the host's proximity to truth. No new pixels enter the catalogue collar and no block is emptied.
h33-h33-2-b2-CONCb10px-m10-20261023-89ff.non_fault_mimic: Pleistocene Lake Lahontan benches and GeoDAWN E-W flight-line corrugation both survive edge filters and pack into km-scale bands; welding dots onto them raises M only if the host is actually near truth, so a mimic shows up as a null (m_add ~ 0), not a false gain. Conversely, alluvial geothermal outflow along range fronts forms km-scale clusters with no fault slip, which would produce a real m_add but nothing in T.
h33-h33-2-b2-CONCb10px-m10-20261023-89ff.predicted_sign_size: MODEL +0.011 live, scenario range [-0.002, +0.030]. Point scenario: m_add 0.30, t_rm 0.02, m_rm 0.02, t_add = 0.2 m_add, calibrated on the two CLAIM pairs (0.2778 / 0.2600). The sign is not guaranteed: at m_add <= 0.15 and t_rm >= 0.02 the recall lost from the donors dominates.
h33-h33-2-b2-CONCb10px-m10-20261023-89ff.confounder: CV excursion. Under every estimator tried, R0 sits at 0.62 (raw 1 km counts, occupied blocks) / 0.48 (5 km-smoothed density); these variants push it to 1.02-1.36 / 0.67-1.07, far outside the 0.51-0.59 band the brief quotes for the best files. If that band is causal and not an artefact of the estimator, the live change should be negative even though the algebra predicts positive. That is the cleanest way to falsify the folklore.
h33-h33-2-b2-CONCb10px-m10-20261023-89ff.falsifier: Live change <= -0.010: concentration past the parent costs real recall, the cold-tail donors were catching isolated blind faults, and the axis is closed. Live change in (-0.010, +0.010): the metric's redundancy credit is too small to matter at 10-20 % and the axis is closed as sub-noise at this dose. Live change >= +0.010 with the 20 % move > 10 % move: mechanism confirmed, scale the dose and combine with the best MASS setting next session.

Shifting each d_cat > 3 px dot <= 2.0 px within its H19-5 ribbon onto the local topographic-scarp and TMI/gravity horizontal-gradient maximum increases kernel coverage T without leaving the parent detector support.
h33-h33-2-b2-SNAPridge2px-20261023-83d2d.mechanism: At fixed count S = 37,654 (Delta S = 0), moving a dot by <= 200 m toward a fault axis increases both numerator coverage T and self-credit M, yielding Delta DTI = [(1 - 0.2*DTI)*Delta T + 0.2*DTI*Delta M] / [D + 0.2*(Delta T - Delta M)] > 0 whenever Delta T > 0 and Delta M >= 0. Enforcing d_nn >= sqrt(8) = 2.828 px prevents adjacent dots along strike from bunching onto a single peak and opening >300 m kernel gaps.
h33-h33-2-b2-SNAPridge2px-20261023-83d2d.non_fault_mimic: Erosional facet spurs and asymmetrical footwall crest rounding on range fronts can shift the 100 m detrended-elevation slope peak 100-200 m upslope of the basal fault trace inside a 2-3 px H19-5 ribbon.
